architecture.mechanism: Automated interpretable scientific modeling that generates deeper, actionable insights from complex datasets to identify hidden patterns undetected by standard methods.
architecture.intervention: Deploy an automated machine learning interpretability system on the engine powertrain controller area network data logs to extract rich interpretability artefacts identifying transient sensor signal anomalies or actuator command dropouts during accelerator pedal depression that standard dealer diagnostic trouble code scans fail to flag as faults.
architecture.expected_effect: Identification of the specific intermittent electrical or software root cause triggering the stall, enabling a targeted repair or calibration update that restores reliable acceleration under all operating conditions.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle through 100 consecutive wide-open-throttle acceleration events while logging controller area network bus traffic; if the interpretability model identifies no anomalous signal pattern and zero stalls occur, the hypothesized undetected root cause is falsified.
